scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the stochastic model, positivity theorem, moment bounds, permanence theorem, persistence-in-mean definition and theorem, extinction theorem, and numerical parameter section. The scalar logistic comparison was proved directly from its explicit solution, while cooperative-system and stochastic-logistic literature were inspected to delimit prior coverage. The deterministic jellyfish predecessor was checked for stage-specific persistence context. The bundled exact-arithmetic verifier checks the source-parameter application and weighted drift cancellation. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem establishes persistence in mean, not two-stage stochastic permanence in probability. It gives no positive lower time-average bound for the medusa stage under arbitrary medusa noise. The upper mean bound is sufficient and not claimed sharp.

title: Polyp self-renewal makes mean persistence independent of medusa noise
